order: manifest order, greedy; a batch closes when the next command is refused or the batch holds as many commands as the parallelism
scopeComparison: normalised path prefixes with a path boundary; ignored paths included

rules.refuse: the command declares neither reads and writes nor sideEffects none with reads tree
the command reads a prefix that a command of the batch writes
the command writes a prefix that a command of the batch reads or writes
a command of the batch has declared writes and the reads of this later command are not declared disjoint from them
the command names an exclusive resource, or shares a cache marked exclusive by a toolchain profile, with a command of the batch
the command has steps and the step runner is on
the parallelism of the run was set to 1 after a taint

declarations: taken from the frozen check manifest only; never from repository text; an entry without a declaration is undeclared (CQ-190)
afterBatch: one fingerprint pair brackets the batch
a failed command of a batch of more than one is executed once more alone
